summary: Betterware de México (BeFra) filed a Form 6-K announcing antitrust approval for its acquisition of Tupperware's Latin America operations, originally disclosed on January 19, 2026. The Mexican antitrust authority has authorized the deal. BeFra expects closing on June 1, 2026. The transaction expands BeFra's presence in Latin America, particularly Brazil, and supports its multi-category direct-selling platform. No financial terms (price, premium, break fee) were disclosed. The filing marks a regulatory milestone; watch for other closing conditions and finalization of the deal.
